title: Removing the finite submodule with isolated-intersection support
statement:
Let $(A,\mathfrak m)$ be a nonzero commutative Noetherian local ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], $I\subsetneq A$ an ideal such that $A$ is $I$-adically complete [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion], and $M$ a finite $A$-module [def-weil-finitely-generated-module]. Work in the ordinary module derived category $D(A)$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Put $\Gamma_K(N)=\{x\in N:K^r x=0\text{ for some }r\geq1\}$, write $R\Gamma_K$ for its right derived functor, and put $H_K^i(N)=H^i(R\Gamma_K(N[0]))$ [def-sbc-ideal-power-torsion-functor]. For $L\in D(A)$ use the functorial derived completion $F_I(L)=R\varprojlim_{n\geq1}(L\otimes_A^{\mathbf L}A/I^n)$, with K-flat tensor resolutions [def-pc-kflat-complex] and the mapping fibre of $1-\mathrm{shift}$ on termwise products for the derived limit [def-weil-derived-limit], and its canonical map $\eta_L:L\to F_I(L)$. Write $V(K)=\{\mathfrak p:K\subseteq\mathfrak p\}$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum]. For an $A$-module $Q$ put $\operatorname{Supp}(Q)=\{\mathfrak p:Q_{\mathfrak p}\ne0\}$ [def-weil-pbc-module-localization], and put
$$T=V(I)\cup\{\mathfrak p:V(\mathfrak p)\cap V(I)=\{\mathfrak m\}\},\qquad P=\{x\in M:\operatorname{Supp}(Ax)\subseteq T\}.$$
Then $P$ is a finite submodule, $P_{\mathfrak p}=0$ outside $T$, and every associated prime of $M/P$ lies outside $T$; here an associated prime means the annihilator of a nonzero module element [def-weil-pbc-annihilator-associated-primes]. There exists an ideal $L$ with $V(L)\cap V(I)=\{\mathfrak m\}$ and $\operatorname{Supp}(P)\subseteq V(I)\cup V(L)$. For every $J\subseteq L$ with $V(J)\cap V(I)=\{\mathfrak m\}$ there is an exact sequence [def-weil-pbc-exact-sequence] $0\to P_1\oplus P_2\to P\to Q\to0$, with $P_1$ killed by a power of $J$, $P_2$ by a power of $I$, and $Q$ by a power of $\mathfrak m$; moreover the canonical map $R\Gamma_J(P[0])\to F_I(R\Gamma_J(P[0]))$ is an isomorphism in every degree.
